nodes.description: Private owner address; privileged account controlling init, batchSend, _mints and delegate.
Public balance mapping, mutated with raw arithmetic in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping, decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Private sale whitelist mapping toggled by _mints; whitelisted addresses bypass the ensure() trading checks.
Private per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and read by condition().
Private minimum sale amount set only by init().
Private maximum sale amount set only by init().
Private allowed number of sales per address set only by init().
Whitelisted trading address; writable by anyone through setTradeAddress (no access control).
Public total supply minted in the constructor.
Public constant decimals (18) used for scaling amounts.
Hardcoded constant router address compared against _from inside ensure().
Public payable ERC20 transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view whitelist gate that derives the pair via pairFor and otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transfer entry point performing allowance and balance updates with raw arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit validator over _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-gated function executing delegatecall on a user supplied address and calldata.
Mint/whitelist function callable by owner or one hardcoded address; sets balanceOf and canSale.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution using unchecked _value*_tos.length and unchecked balance math.
Unguarded setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure().
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and router allowance.
Private helper performing a low-level call to a token contract and decoding optional return data.
Caller-controlled sender used for authorization, allowance keys and owner assignment.
delegatecall to an arbitrary user supplied address, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
Low-level address(token).call(data) invoked on an external token contract.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value (no SafeMath).
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value after a >= require.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value (no SafeMath).
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length that can overflow the local total.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Target address a of the delegatecall in delegate().
Calldata b passed to the delegatecall in delegate().
Recipient array parameter of batchSend.
Per-recipient value parameter of batchSend.
Sale count parameter of init.
Minimum sale token amount parameter of init.
Maximum sale token amount parameter of init.
Account credited and whitelisted by _mints.
Mint amount parameter of _mints.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Spender parameter of approve.
Local total = _value * _tos.length used for the balance check.
Local pair address computed by pairFor inside ensure().

edges.reason: transfer() delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of the nested transferFrom call.
msg.sender is checked against _from and used as the allowance spender key.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
delegate() performs a delegatecall into a user supplied address, executing untrusted code.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b supplies the calldata of the delegatecall.
_mints() authorization compares msg.sender against owner and a hardcoded address.
spender parameter is credited in balanceOf and whitelisted in canSale.
addedValue parameter determines the minted balance amount.
_mints writes balanceOf[spender] directly.
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, granting the whitelist bypass of ensure().
init() requires msg.sender == owner.
init assigns _minSale.
init assigns _maxSale.
init assigns _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend computes local total from _value and _tos.length.
The unchecked multiplication result is stored in local total.
_tos.length feeds the unchecked multiplication.
_value feeds the unchecked multiplication.
batchSend executes the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication.
batchSend debits msg.sender and credits each recipient in balanceOf without SafeMath.
batchSend derives the debited balance and the emitted sender from msg.sender.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress slot with no owner check.
The addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress by any caller.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_value parameter is the assigned allowance.
_spender parameter is the allowance key.
approve grants allowance on behalf of msg.sender.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the balanceOf mapping.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the allowance mapping.
_value is the operand of the unchecked allowance subtraction.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value addition.
Unchecked addition mutates the balanceOf mapping.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance addition.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom validates allowance[_from][msg.sender] against msg.sender.
_from parameter drives the debit and whitelist checks.
_to parameter is the credited recipient.
_value parameter drives all amount arithmetic.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
condition reads _minSale.
condition reads _maxSale.
condition reads _saleNum.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the expected pair address.
pairFor return value is bound to the local _UNI.
Local _UNI is compared against _from in ensure().
ensure compares _from/_to against owner for the privileged whitelist shortcut.
ensure reads tradeAddress for the whitelist shortcut.
ensure reads canSale[_from] for the whitelist shortcut.
ensure compares _from against the hardcoded UNI constant.
callOptionalReturn makes a low-level external call into a token contract before validation completes.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, defining all privileged access.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
Constructor pre-approves the router address with uint(-1) allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Amount parameter is only meaningful as the operand of transferFrom's allowance and balance updates.
Source address parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom's debit and ensure checks.
Recipient parameter is only meaningful as the credited key inside transferFrom.
Target address parameter is consumed directly by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Calldata parameter is consumed directly by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Recipient array parameter only scopes the loop and balance credits of batchSend.
Value parameter only scopes the amount arithmetic of batchSend.
Initializer argument written straight into contract sale configuration.
Mint recipient parameter only used to write balanceOf and canSale inside _mints.
Mint amount parameter only used to set balanceOf inside _mints.
Setter argument is written directly into the tradeAddress state variable.
Allowance amount parameter only scopes the allowance write in approve.
Spender parameter only scopes the allowance key in approve.
Local total is produced solely by the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
Local _UNI is bound solely from the pairFor return value and used in the ensure whitelist check.
